item.title: Pope Leo recovering from surgery after lung cancer diagnosis | First Thing
item.description: Vatican says operation on US-born head of Roman Catholic church was ‘successful’. Plus, after six decades in the US, Joni Mitchell has become a citizen Don’t already get First Thing in your inbox? Sign up here Good morning. Pope Leo XIV, the head of the 1.4 billion-strong Roman Catholic church, has been diagnosed with lung cancer . The Vatican made the announcement after Leo, 71, the first US-born leader to assume the role, underwent an operation and had the lower lobe of his right lung removed. A statement said the surgery was “successful, on schedule and as planned”. The Vatican said Leo had “now returned to his room” after the operation.
